name: Northeast Couloir
itinerary: Approach from the Stuart Lake Trailhead to a camp near Lake Stuart or the base of the couloir; alpine-start to climb the couloir (snow/ice to roughly 50 degrees) to its top, then scramble up and right to the Balanced Rock summit via a short 5.0 pitch; descend the same route or via Sherpa Pass.
approach: From the Stuart Lake Trailhead, hike the Stuart Lake Trail through the beaver meadows; at the first switchback (about 1.5 miles past the Colchuck/Stuart Lake trail fork), leave the trail to the south on an obscure, unmaintained climbers' path, crossing Stuart Lake creek on logs, to reach the base of the northeast-facing couloir below Sherpa Peak. The path is unmaintained and can be hard to follow.
